source_notes: Sponsor Botala Energy (ASX/BSE: BTE) now targets FID on the Serowe CBM-to-LNG project in H2 2026 and 'first LNG to flow and be delivered in 2027' (Energies Media, 12 Jan 2026; corroborated by NewVision, 9 Dec 2025: 'first LNG supply targeted for 2027-2028'). With FID not taken until H2 2026, the GEM Phase 1 LatestPlannedStartYear of 2026 is no longer achievable. Phase 1 = the ~200 t/day Galileo Cryobox unit (~0.07 mtpa, matches GEM). OriginalPlannedStartYear deliberately left at 2026 (records the original plan).
scope_note: Per-unit timing field; applies to Phase 1 unit row only. Phase 2 LatestPlannedStartYear (2028) unchanged — still consistent with current sourcing.
